en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a large Renaissance-style riverside castle with multiple wings, towers, and a tall spire, situated on the bank of a wide river. In front of the castle is a metal bridge crossing the river. A sailing boat with two people is in the foreground, and the buildings and bridge are reflected in the calm water. The printed caption at the top reads "Torgau a. Elbe. Schloß Hartenfels".
